breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble, offering two conflicting definitions for Nx and dx. The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect, contradictory sentence. The agent successfully identified this conflict, discarded the incorrect definition (dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)), and correctly specified the grid based on the periodic domain requirements (dx = 1/Nx), which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
